tasks.spec: total_outstanding, highest_interest, next_emi. AvalancheCalculator (order by interest_rate desc), SnowballCalculator (order by outstanding asc), payoff_plan() combining EMI + any surplus by the chosen order. Simulator(extra_payment, salary_increase, bonus) -> {months_saved, interest_saved, new_payoff_date} via month-by-month amortization. Identity: extra_payment 0 and no other change -> months_saved == 0, interest_saved == 0.

APIRouter: /debt/overview, /debt/table (+ {id} GET/PUT/DELETE, {id}/archive), /debt/payoff-plan, POST /debt/simulate (body extra_payment/salary_increase/bonus), /debt/learning/{topic}. {id}/archive sets archived_at OR status='closed' when outstanding<=0. Hard delete blocked if payment history exists (409).

Wraps the debt calculators; __init__(self, llm_client). Returns {action, reason, learn} where action/ranking is deterministic and only the prose is llm-rendered. High-interest debt ranked above goals/investing per master doc section 2.

Debt table, payoff-plan view, a simulate form (extra payment / salary increase / bonus inputs -> POST /api/finance/debt/simulate via useSubmit, show months & interest saved), and a learning panel showing Action / Reason / Learn. Fetch via useFinanceData. Explicit empty state when no debts.
